officialRef.pdf: 小升初第3辑初中时文阅读提分训练3+X第3辑小升初答案.pdf

q1.explanationZh: 第二段说他们先打扫房子，然后用气球和花把客厅装饰起来，所以填 decorated the living room。

evidence.quote: we decorated our living room with colourful balloons and flowers.

q2.explanationZh: 第二段说早上妈妈带 Lucy 去看外公外婆，所以外公外婆是“来看”我们，填 came to visit。

evidence.quote: Mum took Lucy to visit my grandparents.

q3.explanationZh: 第三段说 Lucy 和妈妈、外公外婆一起回到家，所以填 came home（或 went back home）。

evidence.quote: When Lucy came home with Mum and my grandparents, she was surprised.

q4.explanationZh: 第二段说爸爸把一个大蛋糕放在客厅桌子上，所以填 a big cake。

evidence.quote: Dad placed a big cake on the table in the living room.

q5.explanationZh: 第二段最后说我在蛋糕上插了八根蜡烛，所以填 eight candles。

evidence.quote: And I put eight candles on the cake.

q6.explanationZh: 第三段说 Lucy 和妈妈、外公外婆回到家，客人们都在她家，所以她们是回到 Lucy’s house。

evidence.quote: When Lucy came home with Mum and my grandparents, she was surprised.

q7.explanationZh: 第三段说下午客人们都到了，arrive at 表示“到达”，填 arrived at。

evidence.quote: In the afternoon, all the guests arrived.

q8.explanationZh: 第四段说唱完歌，小寿星把蜡烛吹灭，过去式是 blew out。

evidence.quote: the birthday girl blew out the candles.

q9.explanationZh: Lucy 看到这么多客人，事先不知道有派对，所以感到 surprised（惊讶）。

evidence.quote: When Lucy came home with Mum and my grandparents, she was surprised.

q10.explanationZh: 第三段最后说妹妹看到这么多客人非常高兴，所以填 happy。

evidence.quote: My little sister was very happy to see all of these guests in our house!

q11.explanationZh: 第四段最后说大家吃蛋糕、送礼物，一起玩得很开心，have a great time 就是玩得开心。
